featured_reviews.review_text:
I don't usually write reviews, but this experience left such a strong impression on me that I felt compelled to share it.

I recently attended Sahiba's Salsa workshop, and it completely blew my mind. The way she explained the context, history, foundations, and intricacies of Salsa was unlike anything I've experienced in my entire dance journey. In just two days, I learned concepts and insights that many teachers don't cover—or even mention—in years of training.

What truly sets Sahiba apart is not just her depth of knowledge, but also her passion, clarity, presentation style, and presence. Every session was engaging, eye-opening, and packed with value. She has a remarkable ability to make complex concepts easy to understand while helping students connect with the essence of the dance.

For me, this wasn't just a Salsa workshop; it was a masterclass in teaching itself. There is so much that dance instructors can learn from the way she shares her knowledge.

If you ever get the opportunity—or are fortunate enough to have her teaching in your city—don't miss it. The time and money invested will be more than worth it. And if Google allowed more than five stars, I would gladly give them all to her.

featured_reviews.name: Niyati Magdani
featured_reviews.review_text:
I was never a dancer until I attended a salsa/bachata social at Khar Social, organised by Dance Design, and I had absolutely no clue what I was doing. It felt quite intimidating at first, but at the same time, it looked like such a fun and refreshing way to unwind. Everyone around me was enjoying themselves so much that I decided to join a class the very next day.

Two years later, I can confidently say it’s been one of the best decisions I’ve made. From feeling completely overwhelmed by social dancing to genuinely falling in love with it — the journey has been incredible. I can’t imagine my routine now without classes and socials.

More than just dance, it has given me confidence, a sense of belonging, and some amazing friendships. What started as something intimidating has now become a huge, joyful part of my life — it truly feels like a community.

Special shoutout to Sahiba and Joshua — their classes are amazing and make learning so enjoyable.

10/10 would recommend social dancing with Dance Design to anyone who hasn’t tried it yet!
